title: SGLT2 inhibitors vs placebo for hospitalization for heart failure in mixed cardiovascular-outcome trial populations
question: In adults with type 2 diabetes or at cardiovascular risk in cardiovascular-outcome trials that include participants with and without baseline heart failure, do SGLT2 inhibitors reduce hospitalization for heart failure versus placebo?

comparator_scope_note: Zelniker 2019 (PMID 30424892) is the closest CVOT-scope comparator but Unpaywall reported it closed access. The OA comparator used here (PMID 33519713) reports SGLT2 inhibitor effects on heart-failure hospitalization in type 2 diabetes RCTs and is therefore a scope comparator, not a same-estimand HR benchmark.
